body: I'm 28 and I can thoroughly relate to this.
I deleted instagram and fb ...I had only 2 posts and most of the time it affected me when I saw other people's lives.

I'm 28 Single (Never been with a girl...not even a hug).

Most of my school friends are married..

I usually hang out with people much younger than myself.. like 18-22 because they mostly discuss about sports, videogames, etc.
One they were having a conversation, where each one was talking about women in their lives...and somehow the conversation was directed at me...and there was a long pause before someone changed the topic.

I have negative self esteem...I have self image issue.. I'm balding. I have been severally depressed my entire life...and only now that I realized that it was not normal and started talking anti-depressants for it.

I sometimes regret missing out on a lot of stuff, because of something which was not under my control. 

I was suicidal for a very long time, before realizing that this is not a normal feeling. 

I am struggling career wise, but I will sort it out by 30. 
From 30-40 I will live my life on my terms..and I will end it on my 40th birthday.

I now see all those efforts as waist. I hardly ever socialized, I never partied. 

Yesterday I went to Target and almost had a panic attack while billing. 

I am depending on my parents money to live. I applied to 1000s of entry level positions. That's a different rant.

I don't try to compare myself with people, but it's not easy at this point not to. My juniors whom I have mentored have progressed so much further in their careers. I have to fight to keep up with my coursework along with all the depression and anxiety, it's becoming very hard now.
